_: Judgements on aliases that are also some other title's canonical name. See
scripts/check-alias-collisions.py, which refuses a publish on any such alias with no decision here.
'drop' means the film was never released or known under that name and the Wikidata altLabel is wrong;
the store build removes the alias (store/aliases.py). 'keep' means it is a real alternate title and stays, even
though it collides — that is what lets 'parasite' find 기생충 and '96 hours' find Taken.
Matching ignores punctuation, accents, leading articles and format suffixes, so one entry covers every
spelling of the same name. 'why' is the evidence, not a restatement of the verdict.

drop.why: Taxi Driver has never carried this title in any market. Wikidata Q47221 (confirmed as Taxi Driver by P4947 103 and P345 tt0075314) holds it as an en skos:altLabel; TMDB lists no such alternative title. It put Taxi Driver SECOND for q=alien, above Aliens, Alien3 and Alienoid.
